text.en:
The Miag-ao National Vocational High School in the Municipality of Miag-ao, Province of
Iloilo, is converted into a national polytechnic college to be known as the Southern Iloilo Polytechnic College.

In addition to the secondary vocational course, the college shall offer undergraduate and
graduate courses, industrial technology, sciences, arts, and other courses as may be authorized by the Ministry
of Education, Culture and Sports. It shall also offer short-term vocational courses.

All personnel, assets, liabilities, records, and appropriations of the Miag-ao National Vocational
High School are transferred to and shall be absorbed by the Southern Iloilo Polytechnic College.

The amount necessary for the operation and maintenance of the College shall be charged to the
appropriations in Batas Pambansa Bilang 230 intended for the Miag-ao National Vocational High School
under the ministry of Education, Culture and Sports. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the same
purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 7, 1984
